about_the_game:
It's Little Guy Friday, and you're heading to the Uncool Underground to face the Leet 14 and become the champion!

Well, champion in this part of the tri-state area at least.

Little Guy Friday is a creature collecting roguelike featuring clever turn based combat. Face a gauntlet of quirky trainers each with their own lineup of Little Guys, homemade creations made of junk and powered by imagination.

Along the way, you’ll build your team by finding and adopting new Little Guys, learning to mix and match their unique quirks to master the gauntlet. Some may ascend gloriously while others will fall in battle as you reshape your squad throughout the run.

Face the Gauntlet, Master the full roster of Little Guys, and become Champion!

Don't worry, either way you'll get to see plenty of silly Little Guys!
